headlines.label: Overtakes
headlines.detail: On track after lap 1 · most: PIA (8)

summary: Lando Norris won the Australian Grand Prix from pole position, 0.9s ahead of Max Verstappen, with George Russell completing the podium.
Kimi Antonelli made the biggest climb, from P16 to P4.
Yuki Tsunoda had a day to forget, dropping from P5 to P12.
The race was neutralised by 3 safety cars.
The stewards penalised BOR (5 second time penalty) and ANT (5 second time penalty).
There were 82 pit stops in total; the winner stopped 5 times.
Rain fell at some point during the race.
Lando Norris takes the championship lead, 7 points ahead of Max Verstappen.
